description: Sets the absolute measurement for the vertical positioning of the floating object.

params.description: The document element which will be taken as a countdown point for the object vertical alignment.
params.name: sRelativeFrom

params.description: The distance from the bottom part of the document element to the floating object. Use EMU for absolute units or a number (1 = 1%) when bPercent=true for percent relative positioning.
params.name: nDistance

params.description: The option defining whether the vertical alignment offset is specified in percent.
params.name: bPercent

signature: SetVerPosition(sRelativeFrom: RelFromV, nDistance: EMU | number, bPercent?: boolean): boolean
